Method of Attack: Attack combined with Active Directory (AD) attack
Pushing LockerGoga ransomware to compromise systems
Impacted Systems: Norsk Hydro computer systems in most business areas
Windows domain type network using Active Directory
Attack Vector: Cyber attack targeting Active Directory and network systems
Indicators of Compromise: Network down with company website showing 404 error
Infection confirmed by Norsk Hydro CFO Eivind Kallevik
Notification and alert issued by NorCERT
